slides.title: A Sunny Morning
slides.text: Bella Bear loved sunny mornings. She walked in Sunny Forest. Birds sang happy songs. Up ahead, she saw Grandma Bear by her door. Grandma was holding a big basket. It was full of juicy berries. The basket looked very heavy. Grandma looked a little tired. "Hello, Grandma!" Bella called out, with a kind smile.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Bella Bear and Grandma Bear in Sunny Forest. Emphasize Grandma's tiredness and the heavy basket.

slides.title: Grandma Needs Help
slides.text: "Oh, hello, dear Bella!" Grandma said with a soft smile. "This basket is so heavy today. I picked many juicy berries for jam. My arms feel very tired. I need to take it inside." Grandma sighed softly. Bella saw Grandma's tired face. She wanted to help her kind Grandma.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Grandma expressing her struggle. Bella notices and feels empathy.

slides.title: Bella's Offer
slides.text: Bella thought for a moment. She had strong little paws. "I can help you, Grandma!" Bella said. "Let me carry the basket." Grandma looked surprised. "Are you sure, dear?" she asked. "Yes!" Bella said happily. She took the basket carefully. It was heavy, but Bella was strong.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella offers help. Show her confidence and strength despite the heavy basket.

slides.title: Carrying the Berries
slides.text: Bella held the big berry basket with both paws. She walked slowly, step by step, towards the door. Grandma opened the door wide for her. "You are such a wonderful helper, dear Bella," Grandma said gently. Bella smiled a big, happy smile. They walked into the cozy kitchen. Bella put the heavy basket safely on the table.
slides.speaker_notes: Depict Bella carrying the basket with determination and Grandma's appreciation. The act of helping is completed.

slides.title: Kind Hearts Make Happy Days
slides.text: "Thank you, Bella," Grandma said. "You have a kind heart." Grandma gave Bella a warm hug. Then she gave Bella some sweet berries. Bella ate the yummy berries. Her tummy felt happy. Her heart felt even happier. Kind hearts make happy days!
slides.speaker_notes: The comforting, happy ending. Bella receives gratitude and a reward, reflecting on the joy of kindness.
